remarks: Village charm meets everyday comfort in this thoughtfully updated Lewiston home! Close to village shops, restaurants, and parks, with convenient access to Canada and Niagara-on-the-Lake, this location puts local favorites and weekend adventures within reach. Heated tile flooring throughout the first floor brings welcome warmth to chilly mornings. The refreshed kitchen features new cabinets, countertops, a gas range, and a dishwasher, creating an inviting space for everyday meals and entertaining. Two updated bathrooms, new wooden stairs, and new luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout the upstairs add style and practicality. Relax in the added three-season room with coordinated flooring and paint, or enjoy the outdoors on the freshly stained porch and deck. Improvements extend beyond the finishes, with a new furnace, electrical updates throughout, basement structural support reinforcement, and a new utility sink with syphon pump. A new sliding rear door rounds out the updates. Furniture is negotiable, offering added flexibility for your move. Discover the comfort of an updated home and the appeal of Village of Lewiston living!
